components.purpose: Page opener at the top of the page: the webinar event title as the Heading, a short description, a register button as CTA 1, and a color gradient background (for example yellow-pink) as requested.
Short agenda in free text, placed directly below the hero. RichTextArea is the free-form text component, and the agenda needs no structured items.

Registration form below the agenda. It is the closest available form: heading, description, submit URL and success/error/loading messages. Its address, phone and email fields are contact details, so they can be left blank for a registration form. Note that no dedicated registration or event form exists on this instance. The FormBuilder and AgilityFormBuilder components are hidden, and NewsletterSignup only collects an email address.
